column1: # KorrinOS wordpen words. code<TAB>word, one per line.
# Every word here is verified drawable at runtime: a word is only shown if the
# resolved font's cmap actually contains all of its codepoints, so a missing
# glyph produces a skipped word, never a row of boxes.
# The optional adult set is in words-adult.tsv and is OFF by default. It is a
# separate file precisely so that a word shown on an unattended screen is a
# deliberate choice, made by whoever set the option.
